records.outcome: the org's skills come from a private GitHub repository registered as an auto-syncing plugin marketplace, Claude has write access to it, and its plugins are attached to a scope
preconditions: a private or internal GitHub repository laid out as a Claude Code plugin marketplace with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the root
for a github.com repository, the GitHub connector must be enabled for the organization
the Claude GitHub App must already be linked to the GitHub organization
the repository archive must be no larger than 512 MiB
steps: Create a private or internal GitHub repository laid out as a Claude Code plugin marketplace, with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the root and one folder per plugin
Fork a public repository into a private one first, since a public repository cannot be selected
Go to the Plugins page at claude.ai/admin-settings/plugins
Click Add plugins and choose Sync from GitHub
Select the repository, leave Sync automatically on, and click Create
Open an Access bundle and go to its Repositories tab
Add the repository to the bundle
In the same bundle's Plugins tab, toggle on the plugins from the new marketplace

evidence.quote: Select the repository, leave **Sync automatically** on (the default), and click **Create**.

records.notes: Step 1 happens on GitHub (third-party-admin surface) and the registration steps in claude.ai admin settings; kept as one variant since they are sequential stages of one path. Verification stated: the repository appears in the bundle's Repositories list and the marketplace's plugins appear in its Plugins tab.

records.outcome: Claude opens a pull request against the skills repository proposing a skill change, which a human still reviews and merges before it reaches channels
preconditions: the skills repository is set up and Claude has write access to it
steps: In the channel, mention @Claude and ask it to open a PR to the skills repo so the skill includes what it just learned
Or ask @Claude to set a recurring routine that reviews the channel's corrections and opens one PR with the fixes
Review, edit, or close the pull request like any contributor's
Merge the PR so the updated plugin syncs to the organization

evidence.quote: Claude won't open skill PRs unprompted. Ask in the channel when something it learned should stick:

records.notes: The review/merge/propagate steps are stated in the 'How updates propagate' table, which is otherwise a concept table.

records.outcome: an uploaded plugin archive is in the organization's catalog and, once toggled on in a bundle or added to a scope, its skills are available in channels
preconditions: a .zip or .plugin archive of up to 200 MB laid out as a Claude Code plugin: a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest at the archive root with skills at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, the same layout inside one top-level folder, or a single top-level SKILL.md
steps: Go to the Plugins page at claude.ai/admin-settings/plugins
Click Add plugins and choose Upload a file
Upload a .zip or .plugin archive of up to 200 MB
Toggle the plugin on in a bundle's Plugins tab, or add it directly on a scope, to make it available in channels

evidence.anchor: ## Upload a plugin as a zip file
evidence.quote: click **Add plugins**, choose **Upload a file**, and upload a `.zip` or `.plugin` archive of up to 200 MB.

records.notes: Archives with no manifest, more than one plugin.json, or a misplaced manifest are rejected at upload. Presented as the alternative to the GitHub-sync path.
